criterion: 主檔可導覽分檔需求、驗收、討論及設計版本；目前、候選、歷史與生成產物位置和責任可區別；引用不重複設計內容，缺檔或錯誤引用能指出。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Compact entries have part/design navigation; missing parts, invalid versions, bad references and unsupported formats report located errors. History overwrite is rejected; candidates are scoped to the selected SPEC.
